title: Worklist version (a prep sheet)
description: One complete, immutable prep sheet written by the coach: a name, a summary, a roadmap of patterns, and the problems to learn (`new`) and to revisit (`revision`), each grouped by pattern in priority order. Sheets carry no dates and no day-by-day schedule. A sheet is never edited after it is published; a change is a new sheet. The app renders it verbatim and makes no decisions of its own.

id.description: `writtenAt` with punctuation removed, e.g. 20261017T212000Z. Also the file name: coaching/worklists/<id>.json.

replaces.description: The version this one was written to follow, or null for the first.

basedOn.description: The evidence the coach read. Lets the app say how much has been recorded since.

trackerCommit.description: Data-repository commit the tracker was read at.

trackerFingerprint.description: `describes.trackerFingerprint` from the data manifest at that commit. Detects edited evidence that an attempt count cannot.

attempts.description: Graded attempts in the tracker that was read.

lastAttemptAt.description: Timestamp (`at`) of the newest graded attempt that was read.

headline.description: One line shown under the sheet name.

name.description: The sheet's name, e.g. "DP push" or "Graphs foundations". Shown as the page title and in the list of sheets.

summary.description: What this sheet is for and how to approach it: focus, what changed and why, what to watch. Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs.

roadmap.description: The pattern roadmap: which pattern builds on which. Shown as a graph above the lists. When present, every pattern used in `new` or `revision` must appear here; it may also list patterns with no problems on this sheet, so the whole path stays visible.

after.description: Patterns this one builds on. Each must be another roadmap entry.

status.description: Where this pattern stands for the user: done, being worked on now, up next, or later.

new.description: Problems to learn: first exposure or new-pattern work.

revision.description: Problems to revisit: cold checks, repairs, transfer checks.

changes.description: Why things changed since `replaces`. Display only: the app computes what changed itself and uses these for the reasons.

migration.description: Present only on a version generated from legacy coaching files.

sourceCommit.description: Data-repository commit the legacy files were read at.

rules.description: Path of the migration rules applied.

excluded.description: Legacy items deliberately not made active, with the reason. Every item in the source days is either active or listed here.

pattern.description: Group name. Reuse the exact name from the previous version.

note.description: One line about this pattern right now.

flag.description: Highlights the item. `repair` marks a weak skill being rebuilt.

mode.description: How to attempt and record it. Defaults: `cold` in revision, `learn` in new.

reason.description: Why it is on the list, in one short line.

detail.description: Longer instruction shown in the problem drawer.

minutes.description: Time box. Omit rather than guess.

sources.description: Legacy provenance, written by the migration.
